title: Mortgage escrow account - federal basics
facts: A mortgage escrow account holds money collected with mortgage payments to pay expenses such as property taxes and homeowners insurance when due.
Federal Regulation X limits the amounts a servicer may require in an escrow account and requires escrow analyses and statements in covered circumstances.
A permitted escrow cushion is generally limited to no more than one-sixth of estimated annual escrow disbursements, subject to applicable law and loan terms.
Not every mortgage must have an escrow account for its entire term; requirements depend on federal rules, loan type, lender terms and applicable state law.
